title: Package registry loose ends after #33610: PATCH-time installedAt doc, PG +00 stamp parse, test order, seeded-disabled statusChangedAt
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwhJBt274G7zk78A5a

Loose ends of #33535, left after PR #33610 merged (review#2 PASS record 6888273785, non-blocking nits). p3, one card for all four.

- **N1 (doc).** A version-changing PATCH restamps the package row, so after a restart `installedAt` reads the PATCH time, not the first install time. Either document this on the PATCH contract or carry the original `installedAt` through a version change.
- **N2.** A `sys_packages` stamp written before #31530 on Postgres carries a `+00` offset suffix that the restore path does not parse, so such a row still falls back to the boot time.
- **N3 (test).** The new restart tests depend on run order through the shared `lastPackageWriteMs`; make each case independent.
- **N4.** A package seeded as disabled gets `statusChangedAt` = boot time on every restart (objectql package registry), the same class of bug as #33535 on a different field.

Area: A5 (service-package / objectql registry). Resume-from: main after #33610.
